scientific_integrity: Infinite proof uses edge-orbit classification and an established directed-tree homotopy theorem. Finite executable orbit and face checks supplement, not replace, proof. No conjectural extension or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical vertex-edge rooted-forest subcomplex, not full strong Morse complexes; independently transitive block-product actions only; 1999 primary publisher full text inaccessible and no independent mathematical validation.
title: Block-transitive fixed loci of the rooted-forest skeleton of strong Morse simplices
